objs.name: document
objs.description: Central managed object representing policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions and other document types subject to lifecycle management including creation, editing, release, distribution and archiving.

attributes.name: document_type
attributes.description: Classification of the document (e.g. policy, guideline, procedural instruction, work instruction).

attributes.name: document_level
attributes.description: Hierarchical level of the document in the document pyramid.

attributes.name: document_abbreviation
attributes.description: Type abbreviation and consecutive number identifying the document (e.g. RL_0001).

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Current version number of the document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the document (e.g. editing, released, out of force, archived).

attributes.name: valid_from
attributes.description: Date from which the released document version is valid.

attributes.name: valid_until
attributes.description: Date until which the document version remains valid, calculated from valid-from plus validity period.

attributes.name: period_of_extended_validity
attributes.description: Configurable duration (default 3 years) after which validity must be re-checked.

attributes.name: archive_duration
attributes.description: Configurable period (default 10 years) after which archived documents are physically deleted.

attributes.name: scope
attributes.description: Areas of validity or relevant companies for the document.

attributes.name: references
attributes.description: Links to other documents or master data referenced by the document.

attributes.name: it_applications
attributes.description: IT applications linked to the document.

attributes.name: relevant_companies
attributes.description: Companies or clients to which the document applies.

attributes.name: source_format
attributes.description: Original Office format of the document content (e.g. Word, Excel, PowerPoint).

attributes.name: language
attributes.description: Original language of the document content.

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled sub-document linked to a main document that is subject to its own versioning and is released together with the main document.

attributes.name: version
attributes.description: Version number of the attachment, following the release cycle of the main document.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Lifecycle status of the attachment mirroring the main document release process.

objs.name: additional_info
objs.description: Supplementary non-controlled sub-document (e.g. brief instructions, photos, screenshots) that is not subject to the main document release cycle and can be published directly.

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: A proposal for changing an existing released document, managed separately without affecting the document content or version history until scheduled for implementation.

attributes.name: status
attributes.description: Current processing status of the change proposal (e.g. created, scheduled, completed).

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request created 30 days before a document's validity expires, triggering a workflow to extend, revise, or invalidate the document.

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate (put out of force) a document that no longer has validity, triggering an archiving workflow.

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to reactivate a previously invalidated and archived document, restoring its validity and authorizations.

objs.name: user
objs.description: An individual person in the system who can hold various roles and participate in document workflows.

attributes.name: role
attributes.description: System role assigned to the user such as Author, Co-Author, Reviewer, Releaser, Reader, or Translator.

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: A named group of users used to assign read or other authorizations to documents (e.g. Reader group, Archive group, Business Admin group).

objs.name: workflow
objs.description: A structured approval or processing sequence supporting document release, validity extension, override, reactivation, or acknowledgement.

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: List of user groups and persons assigned to a document for email notification or acknowledgement upon release.

objs.name: document_template
objs.description: Predefined template associated with a document type, selectable when creating new documents, supporting TAG technology for automatic metadata insertion.

objs.name: electronic_signature
objs.description: Digital signature applied by workflow participants to confirm completion of a workflow step, documented per released version.

objs.name: client
objs.description: A tenant in a multi-client system in which documents can be made visible but not changed.

evts.name: create_document
evts.description: A new document (information object) is created in the system by attaching it and selecting the corresponding document type and template.

evts.name: edit_document_content
evts.description: The content of a document is edited using the implemented editing client in the corresponding Office application.

evts.name: maintain_document_metadata
evts.description: Standardized or customer-specific metadata and attributes of a document are maintained in the properties dialog.

evts.name: convert_document_to_pdf
evts.description: After saving, the document is automatically converted to PDF format for web display.

evts.name: create_attachment
evts.description: A controlled attachment sub-document is created and linked to a main document, triggering a new version of the main document.

evts.name: modify_attachment
evts.description: An existing attachment is modified, triggering a new version of the associated main document.

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: An attachment is marked for archiving and archived upon release of the next main document version.

evts.name: create_additional_info
evts.description: An additional-info object is created and linked to a document without affecting the main document version.

evts.name: delete_additional_info
evts.description: An additional-info object is deleted directly without affecting the main document.

evts.name: start_release_workflow
evts.description: The 3-step release process (Creator – Review – Release) is initiated by the author or a co-author.

evts.name: sign_creator_step
evts.description: The registered author signs the first workflow step of the release process with an electronic signature.

evts.name: review_document
evts.description: A reviewer checks the document content for technical and/or formal correctness during the review workflow step.

evts.name: approve_document
evts.description: A releaser confirms the final release of the document after successful review.

evts.name: reject_document
evts.description: A reviewer or releaser rejects the document during the release workflow, canceling the workflow for subsequent participants.

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: After release, the document is automatically published and made visible to addressed readers.

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: A new editing version of a released document is created for revision, retaining all data from the previous version.

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is created for an existing released document by a user with author rights.

evts.name: schedule_change_proposal
evts.description: A change proposal is scheduled for implementation, triggering creation of a new document version.

evts.name: complete_change_proposal
evts.description: The author documents the editing of an assigned change proposal, marking it as completed.

evts.name: create_validity_extension_request
evts.description: The system automatically creates a validity extension request 30 days before the document validity expires.

evts.name: extend_validity
evts.description: A releaser (or author, reviewer, releaser jointly) confirms the continued validity of the document, updating the valid-until date.

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: A user with write access creates a request to invalidate a document and start the override workflow.

evts.name: approve_override
evts.description: The releaser (or initiator, reviewer, releaser jointly) confirms the invalidation, setting the document status to out of force and revoking authorizations.

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: A member of the Business Admin group creates a request to reactivate an archived document.

evts.name: confirm_reactivation
evts.description: The initiator confirms reactivation, creating a new version of the document with restored metadata and authorizations.

evts.name: distribute_document_by_email
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are notified by email when a new document version is released.

evts.name: distribute_document_for_acknowledgement
evts.description: Users and user groups on the distribution list are requested by email to actively confirm acknowledgement upon document release.

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: A recipient confirms acknowledgement of a released document version via a workflow task.

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Read or write authorizations are assigned to user groups or persons for a specific document.

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: A translator translates released document content into another language.

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: A translated document version is checked and released through a workflow, making it visible in the corresponding login language.

evts.name: physically_delete_document
evts.description: An archived document is physically deleted after the archive duration has expired.

An additional-info object is supplementary to a main document.
A change proposal belongs to and is displayed within a specific document.
A validity extension request is linked to the document whose validity is being checked.

A document can reference another document (e.g. local extension referencing original, or cross-references via attributes).
One or more document templates are defined for each document type and selectable when creating new documents.

Users are assigned to user groups which grant them roles and authorizations.
User groups are assigned to a distribution list for a document.
Individual persons can be directly assigned to a distribution list.
A document can be made visible in specific clients in a multi-client system.
